title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. translated_title: 从表面到体积：用于蛋白质表示学习的配准几何
translated_abstract: 现有的蛋白质几何模型通常使用采样点、法线和曲率等局部几何特征来表示分子表面。虽然这些表示能够有效捕获分子暴露在外的形状，但它们并未显式建模表面之下的体积组织结构，也无法为残基级别的体积结构提供一致的坐标系。我们提出了Protein-TetSphere，一种配准的、残基级别的蛋白质体积表示方法。每条蛋白质链经过四面体化处理，获得与单个残基相关联的局部体积区域，随后将这些区域配准到一个共享的、固定拓扑的四面体参考结构中，并在公共的拉普拉斯基下进行表示。这种配准在残基之间建立了统一的体积坐标系，使得局部三维形变能够与表面信息和化学信息一起整合到多模态蛋白质表示中。我们评估了Protein-TetSphere在……
tldr: 提出Protein-TetSphere，通过将蛋白质链四面体化并配准到固定拓扑的共享四面体参考结构，在公共拉普拉斯基下建立残基间一致的体积坐标系，从而将局部三维形变与表面和化学信息融合到多模态蛋白质表示学习中。
en_tdlr: Protein-TetSphere introduces a registered residue-wise volumetric representation that tetrahedralizes protein chains and registers them to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference in a common Laplacian basis, establishing consistent volumetric coordinates across residues and integrating local 3D deformation with surface and chemical information for multimodal protein representation learning.
